current_direction.title: CASPIAN — THE DAY THE SILENCE SANG
current_direction.reference_role: Both motion-language reference and authorized source for selected production still frames.
current_direction.hybrid_media_rule: Interleave selected exact still frames extracted from the user's reference video with newly generated companion stills that match its dark sculptural portrait/material language. New stills must feel native to the same universe without copying individual frames verbatim.
current_direction.motion_translation: Near-locked composition; internal motion first; localized material invasion/replacement; coherent A/B/C metamorph states; restrained warm fissure-light; bass-driven local pressure rather than global camera shake.
current_direction.visual_material: Near-black wet/matte sculptural relief, obsidian/charcoal organic folds, pale or low-key human/figurative fragments when useful, sparse bronze-gold fissures, bubbles/reflections/voids and dense negative space.
current_direction.story_rule: No literal lyric narrative. The film's progression is an abstract evolution of material states driven by music sections, energy and rhythm.
current_direction.preview_policy: Image previews are enabled when the generation runtime surfaces them.

requirements: Extract and preserve selected source frames from the 145-frame reference video.
Generate companion stills matching the reference visual language.
Record both source-frame and generated assets in ASSET_MANIFEST.json.
Lock the music-driven shot/script map only after the hybrid visual vocabulary exists.
